description: This file defines an Android Activity class that demonstrates displaying an AlertDialog managed by a DialogFragment. It includes methods to show the dialog and handle positive and negative button clicks, as well as a nested static class for the DialogFragment implementation.

classes.name: FragmentAlertDialog
classes.description: An Android Activity demonstrating how to show an AlertDialog controlled by a DialogFragment.

classes.name: MyAlertDialogFragment
classes.description: A static nested class extending DialogFragment that creates and manages an AlertDialog with positive and negative actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets an onClick listener for the button to show the dialog.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Creates and displays an instance of MyAlertDialogFragment with a specified title.

methods.name: doPositiveClick
methods.description: Handles the positive button click captured from the dialog.

methods.name: doNegativeClick
methods.description: Handles the negative button click captured from the dialog.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and returns an AlertDialog with specified icon, title, and button actions.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of MyAlertDialogFragment with specific arguments.
